rule: Every created LeeWay agent or worker must receive both a constitutional persona binding and an acoustic voice package binding.
creationFlow: Runtime resolves persona through Runtime Fabric and acoustic output through Voice Fabric adapter
Speech receipt records agentId, personaFamily, personaArchetypeId and voicePackageId

personaPolicy.inheritanceRule: All LeeWay agents/workers inherit the Agent Lee constitutional persona family unless Creator policy explicitly overrides.
personaPolicy.archetypeRule: Archetype controls delivery register/cadence only; it does not replace agent mission, identity, authority or permissions.

voicePolicy.rule: A persona archetype may be active even when a dedicated matching acoustic package has not yet been created. Never claim a new speaker identity without a verified voice package.
